title: Orthogonality of separated derived t-structure bounds
statement: In the derived category of an abelian category with its standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category], if $A$ lies in $D^{\le n}$, $B$ lies in $D^{\ge m}$, and $n<m$, then every morphism $A\to B$ is zero.
